_comment_general: PRINCIPLE FINAL (debug_IP2) — article-version sampler with IP fixes: warm-restart x1 from v-pred, h_x/lambda_reg tuned for fast measurement convergence, stage-start re-seed of x1.
_comment_langevin: h_x=step for x1 preconditioned ULA; h_epsilon=step for eps ULA (unused when joint_eps=false)
_comment_regularization: lambda_x=WLS ridge; lambda_reg=CG preconditioner ridge; rho_s/rho_e=WLS weights
_comment_cg: CG convergence tolerance and max iterations (30 is usually enough for this problem)
_comment_toggles: Warm-restart x1 from v-pred each outer step is the essential enabler; joint ε update with the warm restart (F2_warm_joint config) converges to the sigma_n^2 * |obs| noise floor on box inpainting.
